items.title: One Nuclear Signs Deal for 2.88-GW Gas-Fired Plant, Large BESS for Louisiana Data Center Campus
items.summary: Florida-headquartered ONE Nuclear Energy said the company has executed a binding letter of intent (LOI) that would provide site control for development of Project Cayman, a 2.88-GW gas-fired power plant and 700-MW/2.88 GWh battery energy storage system (BESS) sited alongside a data center complex.

items.title: ONE Nuclear secures Louisiana site for 2.88GW Project Cayman in US
items.summary: Planned for a site near RiverPlex MegaPark, Project Cayman combines new gas generation, large-scale storage and a data centre.

items.title: Entergy (ETR) Stock May Trade At A 29% Premium As Dividend Growth Drives Value
items.summary: Entergy stock has delivered a strong run over the past few years, yet the current Dividend Discount Model estimate points to the shares trading at a premium to intrinsic value. items.title: Entergy (ETR) Beat Estimates And Reaffirmed Guidance, Is The Stock Still Cheap?
